title: Input marginal of the tree process
statement: Let $\Omega$ be finite, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, and let $T$ be a decision tree on $n$ coordinates. If a process sample is formed by drawing the input from the product distribution $\pi^n$ and recording the tree's query trace, then the marginal distribution of its input is $\pi^n$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
$T$ is a decision tree on $n$ coordinates
